title: Wendell and the Tryouts
premise: Astrid Underhill has spent two years at Hollowmere Academy keeping her scholarship head down, until a recipe card in her late grandmother's box turns out to be a set of instructions for the Tryouts — the town's secret rite that decides who inherits the 'favor' that keeps Hollowmere prosperous. When Astrid accidentally activates her claim, she's dragged into a hidden competition among legacy students whose families have hoarded the favor for generations, and she discovers the favor is fed by something the founders buried beneath the school. With time running out before the centennial Tryouts seal the bargain for another hundred years, Astrid must decide whether to destroy the tradition, inherit it, or rewrite it — and in the end she breaks the old contract, frees what was bound, and gives the town back its choice, at the cost of the scholarship life she'd fought to keep invisible.
about_author: Isandro Crane is a former small-town archivist who writes young adult fiction about inheritance, secrets, and the kids who were never meant to find them. Wendell and the Tryouts is his third novel and the first set in the fictional valley of Hollowmere.

chapters.title: Head Down, Grades Up
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. Establishes her careful invisibility at Hollowmere Academy: the scholarship, the legacy students, the locker she never decorates. She finds an unmarked recipe card tucked into her grandmother's box during a weekend visit home. Emotional beat: loneliness disguised as discipline.

chapters.title: The Card That Isn't a Recipe
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. The card's instructions make no culinary sense — measurements of moonlight, a fold 'against the grain of the year.' When she reads it aloud on campus, the fountain water runs backward. Emotional beat: wonder cracking through caution.

chapters.title: Wendell
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. The groundskeeper's one-eared cat, Wendell, begins following her everywhere and reacting to the card like a compass needle. A custodian warns her cryptically: 'Some names get called whether you answer or not.' Emotional beat: first ally, first dread.

chapters.title: Called
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. At midnight the academy's east door appears where there was only brick; Wendell walks through it and Astrid follows. She witnesses the opening of the Tryouts — a candlelit hall of students she recognizes from class. Emotional beat: vertigo of belonging to something she never chose.

chapters.title: The Favor
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV, with exposition via rival student Marguerite Voss. The favor keeps Hollowmere's orchards endless and its people lucky; every century the Tryouts choose a new keeper. Astrid's grandmother was disqualified decades ago. Emotional beat: anger at the lie her family lived.

chapters.title: Rules of Inheritance
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. She learns the Tryouts' three trials: Memory, Debt, and the Door. Legacy students train openly now that she's a named contender. Her scholarship is suddenly 'under review.' Emotional beat: the radar she hid under is gone.

chapters.title: Marguerite's Version
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. The Voss family has kept the favor three generations running, and Marguerite believes winning is duty, not greed. She studies Astrid as both threat and puzzle. Emotional beat: sympathy for an antagonist who thinks she's the hero.

chapters.title: Trial of Memory
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. Contestants drink from the well and relive a founder's memory. Astrid sees the founding bargain: something bound beneath the school, promised release after a century unless renewed. Emotional beat: horror wearing a pretty face.

chapters.title: What Grandma Knew
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV, flashback-heavy. Home again, she finds her grandmother's journal: she tried to break the contract in her own Tryouts and failed, paying with her name being struck from town records. Emotional beat: grief reframed as inheritance.

chapters.title: Debt
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. The second trial demands each contestant surrender something real. Marguerite gives up her engagement ring; Astrid, cornered, offers her scholarship — and the trial accepts it. Emotional beat: sacrifice as strategy and loss at once.

chapters.title: The Underneath
chapters.summary: Wendell leads Astrid through service tunnels below the academy. She finds the bound thing: not a monster but a person — the founder's sister, made into the favor's engine. Emotional beat: pity where fear should be.

chapters.title: Allies and Appetites
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. Astrid recruits two other outsiders, Dev and Priya, who also entered by accident. Marguerite notices their meetings and must choose whether to report them. Emotional beat: fragile trust forming under surveillance.

chapters.title: Disqualified
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. The proctors expel Dev for 'irregular entry,' proving the Tryouts protect themselves. Astrid realizes the rules bend only for legacy blood. Emotional beat: righteous fury hardening into resolve.

chapters.title: Marguerite's Doubt
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. Preparing for the final trial, Marguerite visits the well alone and receives a memory not of glory but of the first renewal — the screaming. Emotional beat: faith beginning to fracture.

chapters.title: The Door
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. Final trial eve. Contestants must each open the Door and either renew the century-old bargain or claim the favor whole. Astrid smuggles Wendell and the recipe card toward the underneath. Emotional beat: calm before a breaking.

chapters.title: Renewal Night
chapters.summary: Multiple POVs converge. The ceremony begins; the bound sister's voice leaks through the floor. Marguerite hesitates at the Door, and the proctors move to force her hand. Emotional beat: the tradition devouring its own faithful.

chapters.title: What Astrid Offers
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. Instead of claiming or renewing, Astrid reads her grandmother's card aloud inside the circle — a third option written by a woman who lost once already: transfer the debt from the bound to the willing. Emotional beat: courage as authorship.

chapters.title: The Breaking
chapters.summary: Climax. The contract resists; the proctors turn the favor's luck against the students. Marguerite chooses Astrid's side at last, Dev returns through the broken seal, and Wendell reveals he is the sister's old familiar, grown strange with centuries. Emotional beat: everything staked at once.

chapters.title: After the Favor
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. The bargain dissolves; the sister is freed and fades gratefully. The orchards dim, the luck evens out, and the town wakes to ordinary weather and ordinary odds — and to the truth. Emotional beat: exhale after a held breath.

chapters.title: Consequences
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. The academy investigates; families rage; Marguerite publicly testifies about the underneath. Astrid loses the scholarship she sacrificed but gains something stranger: the town's gratitude and a place at the table rewriting the records. Emotional beat: cost acknowledged without regret.

chapters.title: A New Kind of Tryout
chapters.summary: Ensemble POV. Months later, Hollowmere drafts an open civic charter replacing the secret rite — anyone may contribute, no one is bound. Astrid helps archive the old cards beside her grandmother's restored name. Emotional beat: justice built outside the law that protected the secret.

chapters.title: Wendell Stays
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV, closing chapter. On the anniversary, Wendell curls on her windowsill, no longer a guide but a companion. She opens her own recipe box and adds a card of her own — instructions for whoever comes next. Emotional beat: belonging chosen, inheritance rewritten.
